TextView.android:text: Established in 1999, Ikhwa Quran Institute International has been committed to providing authentic Islamic education with sincerity and excellence. Through experienced teachers and a supportive learning environment, we offer online and on-campus programs for students of all ages. Our mission is to strengthen the connection of every student with the Holy Quran and Sunnah while nurturing strong Islamic character and values.

Under the visionary leadership of our Chairman, Ikhwa Quran Institute has continued to provide authentic Islamic education and inspire students to develop a lifelong connection with the Holy Quran and Sunnah.

We organize engaging online competitions such as debating, painting, Milli Naghma and quizzes, giving students opportunities to showcase their creativity, knowledge and skills. Exciting cash prizes and other rewards are offered to encourage and appreciate their participation. We also conduct informative and interactive workshops for teachers and students to support learning, creativity and personal development.
To provide authentic Islamic education, develop love for the Holy Quran and Sunnah, and nurture students with excellent character and strong moral values.
